group: molluscs: Galeommatoidea marine bivalve shells (Goto et al. 2016 Evolution: 302 specimens, ~100 species on final_BEAST.tre; 46 shell-outline landmarks)

data.landmarks: Goto R, Ishikawa H, Hamamura Y, Sato S, Kato M 2016 Evolution 70:1308-1322; Dryad/Zenodo 4938020 (`all_side.tps`: 1 umbo landmark + 45 shell-margin semilandmarks = 46 2D landmarks across 302 specimens).
data.phylogeny: Time-calibrated BEAST phylogeny `final_BEAST.tre` (225 tips; ~100 matched species/OTUs with shell landmarks).

what_thompson_specifically_adds: Mollusc shells are the foundational archetype of *On Growth and Form* (Chapters XI-XV). Because a bivalve valve grows by continuous marginal accretion around the umbo without internal skeletal sutures, its 2D lateral contour should be the purest test of Thompson's 7 smooth coordinate modes anywhere in Metazoa.

hypotheses.statement: Bivalve shells are ultra-Thompsonian: across the ~100 Galeommatoidea species means (46 2D landmarks), the 7 a-priori Thompson modes capture > 85% of between-species Procrustes variance (exceeding fish bodies, insect wings, and vertebrate skulls).
hypotheses.reasoning: Accretionary marginal growth around the umbo generates smooth aspect-ratio, ventral-arch, and anterior-posterior asymmetry gradients with zero internal modular landmarks.

hypotheses.statement: Phylogenetic signal on `final_BEAST.tre` is non-zero: Pagel's lambda > 0.5 (best model != White Noise) in both Thompson-7 and full PCA-95% spaces.
hypotheses.reasoning: Despite repeated transitions between free-living and host-commensal habits, subclades share conserved valve elongation and umbo placement.

hypotheses.statement: Leave-one-species-out phylogenetic prediction on `final_BEAST.tre` beats the grand consensus (median Procrustes RMS ratio < 0.85, paired one-sided Wilcoxon p < 0.001).
hypotheses.reasoning: Dense taxon sampling (~100 tips on a calibrated BEAST tree) provides close relatives within most commensal and free-living lineages.

hypotheses.statement: Thompson-7 captures > 85% of the full-space phylogenetic prediction gain relative to consensus.
hypotheses.reasoning: Because the 46-point shell contour lies almost entirely in the 7-D Thompson subspace, full PCA-95% adds almost no extra phylogenetically predictable signal.
